description.value:
As the pinnacle of your mastery, you may spend 5 focus points as an action to wrap yourself in a sphere formed of all four elements for 1 minute, gaining resistance to cold, energy, fire, kinetic, lightning, and sonic damage, along with a burrow, fly, and swim speed each equal to your walking speed. While active, you may use any of the following as a bonus action:

  • Trigger a small quake in a 15-foot radius around you; each creature there must succeed on a Dexterity save or take 1d6 kinetic damage and fall prone.
  • Loose a 15-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line of fire; each creature in it must succeed on a Dexterity save or take 3d6 fire damage (half on a success).
  • Blast a 15-foot cube of wind centered on a point within 60 feet; each creature there must succeed on a Constitution save or take 1d10 kinetic damage (half on a success), and a Large or smaller creature that fails is also pushed up to 10 feet from the cube's center.
  • Loose a 15-foot cone of ice shards; each creature in it must succeed on a Constitution save or take 2d6 cold damage and have its speed halved until the start of your next turn (half damage and no speed reduction on a success).
